statement: Per (target, candidate) architecture-gate decisions synthesized from frozen committed evidence only. This applies docs/FINAL_ARCHITECTURE_DECISION_RULE.md as a transparent admissibility gate; it does NOT invent thresholds, does NOT rank candidates across datasets/targets, and does NOT declare a final or global architecture.

decision_vocabulary.RETAIN_FOR_TARGET: Sufficient target-specific value AND no disqualifying operational/robustness burden AND gate preconditions met.
decision_vocabulary.CONDITIONAL_FOR_TARGET: Target-specific value is real but context/subject/schedule-dependent, or burden completeness is partial.
decision_vocabulary.DEPRIORITIZE_FOR_TARGET: Current evidence does not justify integration priority; not a permanent-irrelevance claim.
decision_vocabulary.REMOVAL_CANDIDATE_FOR_TARGET: Only when target-specific evidence AND burden are sufficiently complete and preconditions met; never from a single negative marginal alone.
decision_vocabulary.FUTURE_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED: Incomplete or non-comparable evidence on a decision-critical dimension prevents any decision.

global_preconditions.interaction_note: All evidence is one-component-at-a-time. A global minimal subset is NOT provable from independent single-sensor experiments; greedy accumulation of marginals is prohibited (see FINAL_ARCHITECTURE_DECISION_RULE.md interaction precondition).
global_preconditions.cross_dataset_comparability: PROHIBITED (MAE vs macro-F1 and different populations are not rankable)

reasoning.1_scientific_evidence: Positive marginal value; A_cap->B ~0.605 bpm and capacity-matched C->B ~0.776 bpm MAE improvement, 5/5 seeds. Raw A->B ~20.6% is capacity-confounded and must not be read as pure IMU value.
reasoning.2_evidence_strength: strongly_replicated (5 seeds; 3/3 held-out subjects; 4/4 motion quartiles) but capacity-confounded at the raw level and capacity-controlled effect is modest.
reasoning.3_heterogeneity: Direction consistent across subjects and motion quartiles; magnitude non-monotonic with motion; one activity (table_soccer) worse.
reasoning.4_burden_completeness: PARTIAL. Contact/module/compute burden AVAILABLE (zero new body region/module/contact in the colocated wrist reference). Power PARTIAL (IC operating points only). Mass MISSING. Latency MISSING.
reasoning.5_interaction_limitation: No interaction evidence; cannot prove membership in a globally minimal set.

entries.decision_basis: Real capacity-controlled value with near-zero incremental human burden in the colocated wrist reference context; but mass/power/latency incomplete and interaction untested, so retention is conditional, not final.
prohibited_upgrades: Do not upgrade to RETAIN or 'final architecture includes IMU'.
Do not cite the ~20.6% raw figure as pure IMU sensor value.

reasoning.1_scientific_evidence: Aggregate negative marginal (candidate worse), 5/5 optimization seeds; but heterogeneous: 2/4 held-out subjects favor the candidate.
reasoning.2_evidence_strength: replicated_but_variable; aggregate direction dominated by out-of-distribution subject s2; descriptively removing s2 flips the aggregate.
reasoning.3_heterogeneity: High. Subject-level MIXED; activity-level MIXED (walk favors candidate).
reasoning.4_burden_completeness: PARTIAL/MISSING. Adds >=1 physical + optical sensing site (AVAILABLE), but module boundary MISSING, contact-region allocation PARTIAL, mass MISSING, power PARTIAL, robustness evidence MISSING.

entries.decision_basis: For routine HR under current evidence the second site adds a physical sensing site without consistent benefit, so it is deprioritized for HR — but the evidence is heterogeneous and burden is incomplete, so this is NOT a global removal or a universal-uselessness claim.
prohibited_upgrades: Do not upgrade to REMOVAL_CANDIDATE (burden incomplete; heterogeneous; no interaction evidence).
Do not claim the second site is globally useless.
Do not remove s2 to change the headline.

reasoning.1_scientific_evidence: Positive, modest: macro-F1 0.7473->0.7693 (delta ~0.022) on this branch; candidate better in 4/5 training seeds; balanced accuracy 5/5; largest class gains N1/REM.
reasoning.2_evidence_strength: replicated_but_variable; mean effect comparable in magnitude to seed-to-seed SD; PRELIMINARY (first experiment for this target/dataset).
reasoning.3_heterogeneity: Only 3 held-out subjects. On THIS branch: per-subject decomposition NOT computed and NO shuffled-EOG negative control. Both exist on Ismet's unmerged day8-sleep-strengthening-ml branch and are PENDING_SCIENTIFIC_INTEGRATION.
reasoning.4_burden_completeness: MISSING. EEG/EOG components not linked into the HR-focused pareto_decision_inputs; ocular/electrode burden unresolved.

entries.decision_basis: A modest positive signal on a different target and modality that demonstrates the method transfers, but with 3 subjects, preliminary strength, missing negative control and per-subject breakdown ON THIS BRANCH, and no operational burden linkage, the gate returns Future-evidence-required. The pending shuffled control and per-subject analysis (and the prospective secondary holdout) are the specified next evidence.
prohibited_upgrades: Do not claim EOG is necessary or that the final architecture should contain EOG.
Do not display shuffled-control or per-subject numbers as frozen on this branch.
Do not compare macro-F1 to the HR-MAE experiments.

DEPRIORITIZE_FOR_TARGET: heart_rate_bpm / PTT-PPG / second physical PPG site
summary.final_architecture: UNRESOLVED — no target has a RETAIN outcome; interaction evidence unavailable; burden incomplete; cross-dataset ranking prohibited.
